instructions_to_main_agent: Use Expo React Native with expo-router for file-based routing.
Apply 'Performance Pro' archetype: Deep Obsidian background, Pure White text, Volt Green primary actions.
Use NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native) for styling.
Implement Lucide React Native or @expo/vector-icons (Phosphor/Ionicons) for iconography.
Headings must use a condensed heavy font (e.g., Bebas Neue or Barlow Condensed) for an athletic feel. Body text uses Inter.
Go cardless or use tactical minimalism (1px solid borders, no soft shadows, hard corners on buttons) for containers.
Ensure high contrast and large touch targets (min 44px height for interactive elements).
Add 'testID' attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
For the radar chart, use a robust charting library like 'victory-native' or 'react-native-svg-charts'.
Do not use generic 'blue' default styles. The app should feel like a Nike or Adidas training app.

button.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black h-14 items-center justify-center font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
button.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-white text-white h-14 items-center justify-center font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
button.ghost: bg-transparent text-[#CCFF00] h-14 items-center justify-center font-bold uppercase

components.input: bg-[#09090B] border border-[#27272A] text-white h-14 px-4 rounded-lg focus:border-[#CCFF00]
components.badge: px-2 py-1 bg-[#27272A] text-white text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded

image_urls.description: Football players stretching, used as background for Login/Register with heavy bg-black/70 overlay
Boys playing soccer, used as thumbnail for academy news/announcements
Child playing soccer, used as avatar/header for student profile

LoginRegister.layout: Full screen image background with bg-black/70 overlay. Top area for large 'SSB ACADEMY' typographic logo. Middle area for role selection pills (Admin, Coach, Parent). Bottom area for credentials input and full-width sharp-edged login button.

Dashboard_Coach.layout: Bento grid style. Top: 'Welcome Coach' + quick stats (Next Match, Players Present). Middle: Horizontal scroll of today's training schedule. Bottom: Quick actions for Attendance & Skill Rating.

Dashboard_Parent.layout: Top: Child selector (if multiple). Middle: SPP/Fee status card (Red #FF3B30 border if unpaid, Green #34C759 if paid). Bottom: Recent announcements and Match schedule.

StudentList_Coach.layout: Vertical list. Search bar at top. List items show Avatar, Name, Position, and a sparkline or mini-indicator of attendance rate.

StudentProfile.layout: Header: Player photo, Name, Jersey #. Section 1: Radar Chart for 5 dimensions (Teknik, Fisik, Mental, Taktik, Kerjasama) using a charting library, plotted with Volt Green fill. Section 2: Monthly SPP history list. Section 3: Coach notes.

Schedule_Attendance.layout: Top: Date picker ribbon. Middle: Session details card. Bottom: List of students with large touch-target toggle buttons (Present/Absent/Sick) in Volt Green and Red.

Announcements.layout: Feed format. Cards with edge-to-edge images, heavy typography overlaid at bottom of image (bg-black/50 scrim), snippet text below.

motion_and_interaction.tab_transition: Fade and slight scale up for active tab icon.
motion_and_interaction.button_press: Use TouchableOpacity with activeOpacity={0.7} to simulate quick athletic feedback.
motion_and_interaction.list_scroll: Ensure smooth momentum scrolling with showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} for a clean look.
